# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Completed the pending remediation for the canonical chemistry helper layer. Added `don_mg_n_per_l()` and `kh_d()` on both `WaterState` and `TankState`, switched `TankSnapshot` to the canonical KH helper, changed geometry-based `WaterState` constructors to require substrate depth so they seed totals from net water volume, aligned `WaterState::default()` with the default tank's net-water volume, and fixed `TankState::seeded_example()` to rescale dissolved totals and reseed stability baselines after replacing substrate layers. Save handling was hardened by bumping `SCHEMA_VERSION` to 3 so ambiguous schema-2 saves are rejected instead of silently loading with the wrong chemistry basis. Test coverage was expanded to cover all helper methods, zero-volume behavior, constructor semantics, default-state alignment, seeded-example stability seeding, and the schema-2 rejection path.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspected the helper, state, snapshot, save, and regression-test code paths to map each pending amendment to the concrete implementation surface.
1. [Completed] Implemented the missing canonical helper APIs and net-volume semantics by adding DON/KH accessors, updating geometry-based `WaterState` constructors and `WaterState::default()`, and fixing `TankState::seeded_example()` to rescale totals and reseed stability baselines after substrate replacement.
2. [Completed] Hardened save compatibility by bumping the save schema to 3 so pre-net-volume schema-2 saves are rejected instead of loading under ambiguous chemistry semantics.
3. [Completed] Expanded deterministic and property-based regression coverage for every helper method, added constructor/default/seeded-example checks, added a schema-2 rejection test, formatted the workspace, and ran targeted plus full test validation.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -q --test concentration_helpers` completed successfully with 8 passing tests.
- `cargo test -q --test save_load` completed successfully with 5 passing tests.
- `cargo test --quiet` completed successfully across the workspace.
- `crates/tank_core/tests/concentration_helpers.rs` now exercises all concentration/hardness/TDS/conductivity helpers, zero-volume handling, net-volume constructor behavior, default-state alignment, seeded-example stability seeding, and a property test that all helper outputs stay non-negative.
- A final `rg` sweep confirmed the inline KH conversion in `TankSnapshot` was removed; remaining geometry-constructor matches are only the updated canonical APIs and their regression tests.
- No `.beads/` files changed in this remediation pass, so `br lint` was not required.

## Outstanding Risks

- Schema-2 saves are now intentionally rejected instead of migrated because version-2 chemistry volume semantics are ambiguous across builds; any existing v2 save must be recreated or re-exported under schema 3.
- `WaterState::default_for_geometry` and `WaterState::from_source_profile` now require `substrate_depth_cm`; any downstream callers outside this workspace must update to the new signatures.
